effects: Your base ability damage is increased by 30%.
You lose access to Berserk, Death's Swiftness, Living Death, and Sunshine.
body.name: Higher Power

assumptions: The 30% increase is applied to resolved base ability damage before ability damage bands and final hit modifiers.
League-owned ability metadata removes the base ultimate abilities and every replacement or upgraded variant from selection, persisted bars, solver pools, Revolution and cast validation.

reason: Wire Higher Power's base ability damage stage and centralized ultimate availability restriction.

effects: For each unique Blessing path you have chosen, gain:
Choosing the same Blessing path from tier 1 to 6 applies this buff once.
Choosing a mixture of 2 Blessing paths from tier 1 to 6 applies this buff twice.
Choosing a mixture of 3 Blessing paths from tier 1 to 6 applies this buff 3 times.
body.name: True Equilibrium

assumptions: One resolved count of distinct paths from the six persisted path tiers feeds all six stat stages.
Flat ability damage, Armour and life enter their owning pre-final stages; critical chance and damage enter their static layers; Prayer feeds Prayer-scaled blessing effects.

reason: Wire all six True Equilibrium bonuses from one unique-path resolution.

effects: Your maximum life points are reduced by 25%.
Your armour value is reduced by 25%.
body.name: Havoc Born

assumptions: The damage multiplier uses the shared final post-hit pipeline for direct, damage-over-time, poison, conjure, command, proc, attached, reflected, and blessing-generated damage.
The multiplier uses shared stepwise rounding and is applied once to each pipeline damage instance.
Maximum life and total Armour are reduced in final derived stages after additive stat bonuses and other positive blessing multipliers.
Empowered Tuska's Wrath is a fixed non-AD hit that bypasses CombatModifier values in the simulator.
excluded: Fixed non-AD damage paths that bypass the CombatModifier pipeline, such as empowered Tuska's Wrath

reason: Harden Havoc Born's shared damage and final-stat stages with the sole fixed-pipeline exclusion.
